title: Thai Chicken Stir Fry
description: Quick and flavorful stir fry made with chicken, Thai herbs and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic, bell pepper and onion and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai basil, fish sauce, chili flakes, salt and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
